story.title: Family-Friendly Fortnite Streamer Goes Viral After Picking Up GTA 6 And Performing the Ultimate Heelturn, Including a Bloody Zoo Rampage
story.summary: Nice-guy Fortnite streamer Nick Eh 30 has gone viral after trying GTA 6 — and immediately pushing the violence in Rockstar's game to its limit. Nice-guy Fortnite streamer Nick Eh 30 has gone viral after trying GTA 6 — and immediately pushing the violence in Rockstar's game to its limit. For almost a decade, cheery Canadian streamer Nicholas " Nick Eh 30 " Amyoony has amassed a community of millions around his family-friendly Fortnite streams. His personal brand is based on pushing positivity, he's known for never swearing on camera, and he's become one of the few Twitch stars partnered with Epic Games to get a skin of himself made available in-game.
